title: Offline Pipeline And Placement Geometry Refactor
problem: Offline packing and placement geometry were shallow, duplicated modules, making cross-cutting behaviours such as dedupe hard to implement safely.
target_state: pack_images, pack_layout, and pack_layout_items share a deep offline pipeline module, and placement geometry is owned by one crate-private module instead of repeated across algorithms.
evidence: Baseline before refactor: cargo nextest run -p tex-packer-core passed 91/91 on main.
Final core gate: cargo nextest run -p tex-packer-core passed 96/96.
Final workspace gate: cargo nextest run --workspace passed 96/96.

continue_policy.notes: The lane is complete. Split follow-on work for identical-content dedupe or unrelated GUI dead-code cleanup.
